blocks.x: Workforce Scheduling & Field Orchestration: the composed architecture, the platforms underneath and the metric the program is judged on.
The problem this solution exists for
Field and shift operations run on static rosters; demand waves miss capacity; first-time-fix suffers; compliance (hours, certifications) is manual.
Our approach

We build demand-aware orchestration: forecasting into shift and route planning, skills/certs-aware assignment, agentic exception handling (absences, overruns), and compliance evidence produced automatically.
Components

items: Route and dispatch with parts/SLA routing

blocks.x: Platform stack
The solution runs on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Nexus: Many agents operating as one governed, measurable workforce. Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — with a full evidence trail for each decision.
How it runs in an engagement

items: Baseline metrics for this problem locked with owners; current-state decision/data flow mapped in two weeks.
Gated pilot on bounded scope with the testable criterion agreed by finance before the first build sprint.
Staged rollout on the platform stack with SLOs, replay evidence and operator enablement.
Challenger models and policies quarterly; conformance monitoring; annual value audit against baseline.

blocks.x: Prerequisites and data readiness

blocks.x: Industry fit

Deployed across Telecom, Media & Entertainment, Logistics & Supply Chain, Energy & Utilities, Retail & Consumer Goods, Healthcare & Life Sciences. Each industry play adjusts the regulatory frame, the integration surface and the KPI set — the pattern stays, the physics changes.
Outcomes we commit to
How a delivery runs

The cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability, and it does not flex by account. Weeks 1–2 belong to measurement: the baseline metric is captured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 run a bounded pilot — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — steered by a control owner on your side. Weeks 9–12 convert the pilot into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, and close with a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses a gate is stopped or redirected on the record.
